label: violates
requirement: Guests can use a swimming pool located at the booked property for no additional charge during the described stay.
meaning_constraints: Use varied counterexamples: separate fee, pool offsite only, no pool, pool closed all stay, booked room/rate excludes access, decorative pool where swimming prohibited.

clauses.text: Q: Is there a pool on-site? A: This accommodation has no pool; however, the only swimming pool is located at a separate nearby leisure centre.
clauses.rationale: Preserved the lack of an on-site pool and the specific location of the alternative facility.

clauses.text: Dear Client, please note that the hotel pool is closed for repairs for the entire booked stay. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.
clauses.rationale: Maintained the specific reason (repairs) and the exact duration (entire booked stay).

clauses.text: *The booked budget rate expressly excludes the onsite pool; a paid upgrade is needed to access these facilities.
clauses.rationale: Kept the specific rate type (budget), the exclusion of the pool, and the requirement for a paid upgrade.

clauses.text: Please be advised that the onsite swimming pool costs EUR 12 per use, in addition to the room price.
clauses.rationale: Retained the exact fee (EUR 12), the frequency (per use), and the fact it is extra to the room price.

clauses.text: Property Note: This accommodation has no pool. The only swimming pool available is at a separate nearby leisure centre.
clauses.rationale: Preserved the negation of an on-site pool and the specific alternative location.

clauses.text: Please note: The hotel pool is closed for repairs for the entire booked stay. No exceptions apply during this period.
clauses.rationale: Preserved the reason for closure and the specific timeframe of the entire stay.

clauses.text: Regarding your inquiry: The booked budget rate expressly excludes the onsite pool; a paid upgrade is needed for pool access.
clauses.rationale: Maintained the budget rate designation, the exclusion, and the necessity of a paid upgrade.

clauses.text: The onsite swimming pool costs EUR 12 per use. This fee is in addition to the room price.
clauses.rationale: Preserved the exact cost, the per-use condition, and the relationship to the room price.

clauses.text: Pool: None on-site. The only swimming pool is located at a separate nearby leisure centre.
clauses.rationale: Preserved the absence of a pool and the specific location of the nearby alternative.

clauses.text: Important Update: The hotel pool is closed for repairs for the entire booked stay. Please plan your visit accordingly.
clauses.rationale: Preserved the repair reason and the duration covering the entire booked stay.

clauses.text: Policy: The booked budget rate expressly excludes the onsite pool; a paid upgrade is needed for pool usage.
clauses.rationale: Maintained the budget rate specification, the exclusion, and the requirement for a paid upgrade.

clauses.text: Onsite Swimming Pool: EUR 12 per use (in addition to the room price).
clauses.rationale: Preserved the exact fee, the usage condition, and the additional cost status.
